notes:
Summary: Amberline is a contact-center platform operator that licenses a white‑label chat product to large retailers. They operate 500+ enterprise tenants and want to reduce live agent load by moving high-volume, predictable conversations to an LLM deflection layer. Cost is the top constraint — target is to keep inference spend under 15% of current CS ops cost while achieving >=60% deflection on simple flows.

Workload profile / numbers: ~8-12M inbound chat messages/month across tenants; peak concurrency ~4k sessions; typical session length 8-12 turns; latency objective: agent-assist <500ms p95 for autocomplete + <1200ms for deflection flows; throughput: sustain 1000+ async deflections/sec during peak; acceptable cold-start fallback behavior required.

Model & inference preferences: prefer open-models with option to pin to quantized variants (int8 / 4-bit) for unit-cost reductions. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching policies and quantization profiles. Need routing/fallback: primary model for quality (larger), fall back to smaller quantized model when queueing or cost triggers hit. Also want prefix/KV caching for Repeatable FAQ flows to reduce token generation.

Security & compliance: require SSO (SAML), tenant-scoped audit logs, KMS integration (customer-managed keys), and EU data residency for several retail customers. On-prem appliance considered for two large clients (pilot later in year).

POC scope & success criteria (agreed): 6-week POC across three retailers. Deliverables: 1) deploy deflection pipeline (hosted/dedicated hybrid) with prefix caching; 2) run traffic replay of 2M historical chats; 3) achieve >=60% automated deflection w/ <15% deterioration in NPS for handoffs; 4) show >=40% reduction in inference cost per handled conversation via batching/quantization/caching recommendations.

Quotes / call snippets: "We can’t exceed last year’s marginal CS spend by more than 15% — otherwise finance pulls the plug." — Mike Lin (CTO).

Current concerns / technical risks: POC data prep (anonymization) will take 2 weeks; finance expects clear unit-economics report to approve Dedicated commit; security team needs diagram and KMS integration details to progress. Also question about reliability under holiday-like spikes (10x baseline) — need automatic graceful degradation (fallback model/regional routing) and burst capacity plan.

Next actions: finalize SOW and POC S3 upload specs (Jordan), Priya to present infra sizing and kernel/quantization plan 2026-03-10, Rafael to coordinate CSM onboarding if POC passes. Blockers: awaiting security signoff and final PO timeframe from procurement.
